name: Oriel layout
note: How views are put together. Values name tokens from tokens.json; a bare number is DIPs at the default text size. A screen builds from these patterns and parts and writes no size of its own; when a screen needs a new arrangement, it is added here first.
rules: Alignment and space carry the structure: no borders around cards or controls, hairlines only between rows.
Spacing comes from the space scale and nothing else; it follows density through Theme.Spacing.
Text left-aligned; the reading column and the timeline column are centered in what remains beside the pane.
One column of content at a time, at most column wide; the pane and the toolbar are the only fixed frames.
A control is control high; a row in a list is pane-row, row or row-dense high; nothing is in between.

Gaps grow with distance in meaning: space-1 label to control, space-2 related controls, space-3 inside a card, space-4 between groups, space-6 between the parts of a sheet or page, space-8 between pages' parts.
Icons beside 12 and 13 text are icon-s, beside 15 and above icon-m; states use icon-l.
A narrow window (below 760) keeps the structure and narrows the frames: pane-width-narrow, display-compact, the search becomes an icon.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.usage: Narrow pane, compact reader title, toolbar search as an icon, Compact source field 96.

breakpoints.name: panes
breakpoints.usage: Main column width at which the Community kind shows three panes (window 1024 with the pane).

patterns.name: inline
patterns.usage: An icon beside its text: buttons, menu items, status lines.

patterns.name: meta-line
patterns.spec: row, center-aligned, height 20, gap space-1_5; tile-s, meta-strong source, meta muted time; keeps 88 free at the end for row actions
patterns.usage: The meta line of an entry row and the reader's byline.

patterns.name: cluster
patterns.usage: Related controls: a button row, a field and its button.

patterns.name: toolbar-cluster
patterns.usage: Toolbar icon buttons side by side.

patterns.name: bar
patterns.spec: row, height toolbar, center-aligned, padding 0 space-4, leading cluster, spacer, trailing cluster; paper ground; line along the bottom once the content has scrolled
patterns.usage: The toolbar of each screen; the window buttons sit on its middle line.

patterns.name: spacer
patterns.usage: Pushes the trailing cluster of a bar or a row to the end.

patterns.name: column
patterns.spec: centered, max width column (column-social for social), padding 0 space-6
patterns.usage: The timeline and the reader's text column.

patterns.name: stack-tight
patterns.usage: Title and its subtitle; a row's text lines (space-0_5 compact).

patterns.name: stack
patterns.usage: Fields of a form, items of a card.

patterns.name: stack-section
patterns.usage: Groups in a settings page, parts of a card.

patterns.name: stack-page
patterns.usage: Parts of a sheet or page.

patterns.name: inset-row
patterns.spec: padding space-4, leading inset 28 for the unread dot
patterns.usage: An entry row; density Compact is space-2_5 (10).

patterns.name: inset-card
patterns.spec: padding space-3, radius card, surface or soft(meaning) ground, no rim
patterns.usage: Code blocks, notes, the AI card (radius pane), plain cards.

patterns.name: inset-sheet
patterns.spec: padding space-6, radius sheet, float ground, rim line2, shadow-dialog
patterns.usage: Dialogs, the command palette, the key sheet.

patterns.name: inset-popup
patterns.spec: padding space-1, radius card, float ground, rim line2, shadow-popup; rows radius-sm, row high

patterns.name: track
patterns.spec: fill ground, radius pill (radius-control in settings), padding 3, gap 2; chosen segment raised with shadow-raised
patterns.usage: Segmented controls: the timeline scope, Summarize and Translate, settings choices.

patterns.name: divided-list
patterns.spec: rows separated by a hairline line, 28 in from the left and 16 from the right
patterns.usage: Lists of rows in the timeline and settings.

patterns.name: center
patterns.spec: centered on both axes, max width sheet-width, stack-page
patterns.usage: Empty, loading and error states; the connect screen.

patterns.name: grid
patterns.spec: cells at least the part's minimum width, fill the column, gaps from the part
patterns.usage: Video grid, picture grid, picture wall.

parts.name: pane
parts.spec: inset space-2 from the window's edges, radius pane, width pane-width (pane-width-narrow below 760), pane ground; content starts 40 from the top, list padding 8 at the sides
parts.usage: The ink pane.

parts.name: pane-line
parts.spec: 25 from the pane's right edge
parts.usage: The center line of the pane's trailing icon buttons: hide sidebar (32), add (22), Unread first (28), settings (28).

parts.name: pane-item
parts.spec: height pane-row, radius control, padding 0 10, gap 10, tile-m, label; count caption muted at the end
parts.usage: A kind, a subscription, a folder or a settings group.

parts.name: pane-folder
parts.spec: pane-item with a chevron button 22 by pane-row; members indented 22
parts.usage: A folder row and its fold toggle.

parts.name: pane-filter
parts.spec: height row, radius control, fill ground, padding-left 10, gap 6; toggle row square, gap 4
parts.usage: The subscription filter and the Unread first toggle.

parts.name: pane-add
parts.spec: 22 square, radius control, icon-s, on the pane line; row-dense hit area
parts.usage: The add button at the end of a section head.

parts.name: button
parts.spec: height control (control-small Small), radius control, inline with gap 6, icon-s, label (meta-strong Small); padding 14 Primary and Secondary, 8 Danger and Plain, 10 Small; icon only is a square
parts.usage: Every button.

parts.name: toolbar-button
parts.spec: control square, radius control, icon-m fg3; hover and pressed fills; on is soft(accent) with accent
parts.usage: Bare toolbar icon buttons.

parts.name: search
parts.spec: height control, width 200 (min 48) from a 736 wide column, else a toolbar-button; fill ground, radius control
parts.usage: The toolbar search at the far right.

parts.name: select-trigger
parts.spec: height control, min 72, max 240, label + gap space-2 + chevron icon-s; opens an inset-popup at least menu-min wide
parts.usage: Popup-menu buttons in settings.

parts.name: segment
parts.spec: height control-small, radius pill in a capsule (radius-sm in a settings track), meta-strong
parts.usage: One choice of a track.

parts.name: entry-row
parts.spec: inset-row, radius card, gap 14 (10 compact); meta-line, title, body summary fg2, thumb at the end
parts.usage: Article, social and mixed rows in the timeline.

parts.name: unread-dot
parts.spec: dot accent, 11 from the row's left edge, on the title's first line
parts.usage: An unread entry.

parts.name: row-actions
parts.spec: buttons 28 by row-dense, radius-sm, gap 2, icon-s muted; at the end of the meta line; shown on hover, selection and focus with motion-fast
parts.usage: Star, mark read, open in browser.

parts.name: row-compact
parts.spec: height row-compact (30 compact density), radius control, padding 0 16 0 28; source field 128 (96 narrow), title flexible, time at least 56
parts.usage: An article in the Compact viewer.

parts.name: thumb
parts.spec: thumb-w by thumb-h, radius control, outline line2
parts.usage: An article's picture.

parts.name: social-compact-thumb
parts.spec: 56 square radius control; strip of up to four 40 squares radius-sm, gap 4
parts.usage: Pictures of a social post in the Compact viewer.

parts.name: cover-large
parts.spec: 16:9 at the row's content width, at most 640 by 360, radius card; title style under it
parts.usage: A video in the Large cover viewer.

parts.name: video-grid
parts.spec: grid, cells at least 200, gap 16 across and 24 down, padding 16 24 32; 16:9 cover radius card, body title up to two lines 7 below
parts.usage: The Videos scope.

parts.name: picture-wall
parts.spec: up to three columns at least 170, column gap 14, tile gap 20 (10 compact), padding 16 24 32; own aspect ratio (4:3 unknown), radius card, label caption one line
parts.usage: The Images scope, Wall.

parts.name: picture-grid
parts.spec: grid, cells at least 170, video-grid gaps; square picture radius card, label one line 4 below
parts.usage: The Images scope, Grid.

parts.name: badge
parts.spec: radius-xs, caption white on badge, 6 from the corner
parts.usage: Duration (bottom right) and picture count (top right) on a cover.

parts.name: forum-panes
parts.spec: list 320, reader at least 480, hairline between; from the panes breakpoint
parts.usage: The Community kind in the Panes viewer.

parts.name: marker
parts.spec: marker-w by marker-h, radius 2, accent, at the chosen item's leading edge
parts.usage: The selection marker.

parts.name: toast
parts.spec: inverse ground, on-inverse meta, radius control, padding space-2 space-3, icon-m; bottom center, motion-base
parts.usage: Short confirmations.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.spec: inverse ground, on-inverse meta, radius-sm, padding space-1 space-2
parts.usage: Names of icon buttons.

density.note: List density Compact; Comfortable keeps the values above.
